name: 28406-widebatchprefill-dsv2lite16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One in-process vLLM engine, one process.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, bounded at 4096 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: prompt EXACTLY 1024 tokens and output EXACTLY 1 token, so every request has the same shape and the run is a fixed amount of work. No prefix_buckets; the chat template and add_special_tokens put a few more than 1024 tokens on the wire.
purpose: A document classification service scoring 1024-token passages for 32 concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Every key must be top-level and every value must fit on ONE line.
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
# Declared, not a default: an engine that does not pin this can fall back to 2048 and run the
# forward four times narrower than this setup declares.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
